entities.summary: Ranjani Shettar is an Indian visual artist known for her large-scale sculptural installations. Her work has been exhibited at The Metropolitan Museum of Art, the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art. Her works are in the permanent collections of The Metropolitan Museum of Art, and The Guggenheim Museums and Foundation.
